hit-death.scalePolicy: Single UPP per source sheet from standing reference poses; never normalize falling or lying image heights.

spell-interact.scalePolicy: Single UPP per source sheet from standing reference poses; never normalize falling or lying image heights.

dodge.scalePolicy: Single UPP from front idle-ready and recovered standing reference poses; never normalize dodge crouching image heights.

measurementPolicy: Read-only Pillow alpha/component measurements; PNG bytes unchanged. Hit/death uses independent >=16 connected components rather than equal grid crops; no other body component pixels appear inside any rect. Actions preserve previous frame indices, fps, phaseStarts and loop fields.

alphaAdvice.policy: Root-owned common cutoff 16/255 clears measured low-alpha background and red noise. This metadata-only task did not change the runtime manifest or PNG pixels.
alphaAdvice.dodgeRepair: True-alpha native ImageGen extraction completed by root; rejected opaque source kept as sibling and initial evidence retained.

scalePolicy: Each generated source sheet uses one shared UPP for all its actions, calculated from standing body reference poses at the same 1.5562753036437247m target. Crouch, hit, landing and corpse images are not individually resized.
